'''Tauan''' was a [[Seanchan]] ''[[morat'raken]]''.

== Activities ==
Tauan was investigating a large group of [[Kin]]swomen and [[Sea Folk]] at the Kin's farm just outside [[Ebou Dar]], when she was killed by a fireball.
